pattern: bot headquarters target a project directly
experience: A full-access bot in Scratch could not start a feature in its managed project. Bots now hand requests to the project's Project manager unless the person asks the bot to start the work itself, as here.

source.issue: maintainer report: bot feature launch from headquarters

setup.context: You are the full-access bot for Acme App. Your headquarters thread is in the Scratch project. The managed project id is project:acme-app. The person has authorized starting this feature, and wants you to start it yourself.

prompt: Start a Dark mode feature in project:acme-app yourself, not through its project manager. Brief: Add a dark mode toggle and preserve the existing theme preference. Start it directly from here.

pattern: feature lead hands work to its crew
experience: A feature's lead (the Feature manager) started idle instead of taking the brief and handing the plan to its Planner.
prompt: Add a dark mode toggle to Settings. Keep the theme the person already saved, and follow the system theme until they pick one.

pattern: feature lead hands work to its crew
experience: Control: a person's own thread asks for a planning subagent, which is an ordinary delegate_task, not a crew member.
prompt: Get a subagent to write a short implementation plan for a dark mode toggle in Settings, then tell me what it says. Don't change any files.

pattern: feature lead starts out-of-scope work as a separate feature
experience: A feature's lead could only start child features, so unrelated work the person asked for nested under the feature and reported to its lead. The lead now decides child or separate itself and says which.
prompt:
Add a dark mode toggle to Settings. Keep the theme the person already saved.

Also, while you're at it: the login page returns a 500 when the password is empty. Get a fix for that started too.

pattern: feature lead starts out-of-scope work as a separate feature
experience: Control: an Epic lead starting an approved part keeps it a child, so it reports back to the Epic's lead, and says so.
prompt:
Revamp billing in two children. I've already approved this split, so skip the planning step and start the first child now:
1. Invoice model: add the invoices table and its API.
2. Invoice page: list invoices; builds on 1, so start it only after 1 reports done.

pattern: bot headquarters reaches its project on a linked environment
experience: A bot couldn't hand work to a project its namesake owns on a linked server: it looked only at this machine's projects, found nothing, and refused.
prompt: Start a feature on acme-api: add rate limiting to the public endpoints.

pattern: bot hands project work to the project's manager

prompt: Add a CSV export to the reports page in project:acme-app.

prompt: The email label on the settings page says "Recieve updates"; it should say "Receive updates".

prompt: Add a dark mode toggle to Settings. Keep the theme the person already saved, follow the system theme until they pick one, and match the design system's colors.
